evidence: Source reads/edits and cached Java class bytes decoded as data only. No builds, tests, syntax checks, Java/JNI loading, shader/GPU execution, game/process operations or exports.

reference.wingStart: WingsLayer.submit calls the explicit EquipmentLayerRenderer.renderLayers overload with start order 0 at bytecode 0x6f..0x70. The shorter general equipment overload defaults to order 1; it must not be substituted for this wing call.
reference.equipmentOrder: EquipmentLayerRenderer initializes the running order from its explicit argument. Each rendered layer uses order++ for the armorCutoutNoCull base at 0x86..0xa7, then, when hasFoil, order++ for armorEntityGlint at 0xb1..0xd0. It clears its first-layer glint boolean at 0xd5..0xd6. The supported first wing base is order 0 and its glint order 1.
reference.blendRouting: RenderType.hasBlending returns pipeline ColorTargetState.blendFunction.isPresent; GLINT has BlendFunction.GLINT present. SubmitNodeCollection.submitModel routes blended regular models to translucentModels, phase index 7. Glint is therefore order 1 phase 7, ahead of Arctic glow's order 1 custom phase 8, independently of its EQUAL depth/no-write behavior.
reference.glintFactory: RenderTypes.armorEntityGlint returns the static ARMOR_ENTITY_GLINT object. Its setup uses GLINT, the armor artwork, ARMOR_ENTITY_GLINT_TEXTURING and VIEW_OFFSET_Z_LAYERING. No sortOnUpload call occurs in that setup; whole-model phase distance ordering is separate from per-quad sorting. Base armorCutoutNoCull also uses VIEW_OFFSET_Z_LAYERING.

port.locations: PhaseKey and OrderedPhase preserve supported owned collector (numeric order, phase index) locations. Phase.owned_avatar_ordered supplies (0,0),(0,7),(0,8),(1,8); the existing unkeyed owned_avatars wrapper preserves compatibility.
port.groupMapping: Geometry.from_owned_avatar_inputs stores the group indices produced by each distinct ordered phase. Legacy/unkeyed from_uploaded/from_phase_outputs retain unknown locations rather than fabricating them.
port.drawRanges: Plan retains a bounded range slice for every feature group, including empty groups. Pipelines.prepare_groups requires unique increasing selected group indices and reuses the existing complete uploaded-frame/material/range preflight before selecting only those source ranges.
port.entityRecording: record_phase and depth_tracker.record_avatar_phase select only the current supported phase. Unsupported/unknown locations fail; an absent supported phase emits no commands. The legacy whole-frame recorder rejects known owned geometry spanning multiple phases rather than flattening it into one insertion call.
port.glintOrdering: avatar_glint.order_wing_models validates selected known wing IDs in original model order, then uses the shared model_order helper: finite submitted view translations, Mth left-associated float distance, descending Float.compare semantics and the cached fastutil unstable comparator quicksort. No actor/world-position or packet-root equivalence is inferred.
port.glintOwner: GlintGeometry owns its upload-complete base Geometry Arc, actual glint pipeline/constants and selected sorted models. It requires matching base/glint targets, explicit uniforms/poses and all existing artwork/upload/preparation checks. WING_PHASE is (1,7).
port.transaction: Entity full/phase and glint recording share record_transaction. It validates current exact world/batch/list/camera/device/node/surfaces, snapshots restorable native state, retains geometry/glint/native/surface/restore owners through native_draw_assets before commands, rechecks world/surface/snapshot state, emits under private-command classification, and restores state on completion/unwind. Successful glint transactions have a separate counter; no counter was advanced during this source-only work.
port.trackedEntry: depth_tracker.record_avatar_glint uses the existing open-list tracker lock and private-command reentry guard. A PhaseKey is source membership metadata, not proof that the engine is at that callsite.
port.wireCompatibility: No packet/archive/ABI change. Source phase mapping is retained from existing ARCGEO09 inputs; glint model selection/uniforms/view poses remain explicit owning inputs, with no live/replay producer or automatic insertion.
port.jointModelSchedule: WingSchedule now sorts the complete explicitly supplied original owned/foreign sequence and preserves foreign delivery boundaries in a guarded GlintCursor. Native owners perform and acknowledge foreign deliveries between owned-run transactions. Same unsubmitted recording lifetime coalesces bounded asset chunks onto one fence reservation. Source participant/dispatch producers and runtime verification remain missing; see joint-glint-phase-source.json.

remaining: An actual installed-game native phase callsite and native resource/descriptor lifetime owner. These APIs remain unscheduled and do not manufacture a lease.
